items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Oh yeah, I played with Buddy, Austin. I mean a whole lot with Buddy.

ctx.x: Did you play with Buddy Petit any in these years, Moody?
Oh yeah, I played with Buddy, Austin. I mean a whole lot with Buddy. There wasn't no recording though. No, I don't remember no recording.
Yeah the band that was on the same order Chris Kelly's, was you say? Yeah. Some kind of thing.

items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-07-29
items.q: No, I was with, we was with Buddy. Buddy Petitia.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know that school.
We played there for years, you know what I mean? Everything come through there, we played it. Everything. You were with Chris Kelly then? No, I was with, we was with Buddy. Buddy Petitia.
They had us, but dances in the school? That's right.

items.title: Emile Barnes and Paul Barnes Interview, 1959-10-01
items.q: Yeah, I played with Buddy Petit out there. We worked out on Shantown, Louisiana.

ctx.x: They're going again. You were talking, was it Buddy Petit you said you played with?

Yeah, I played with Buddy Petit out there. We worked out on Shantown, Louisiana. We worked out there and the band continued to see Buddy Petit, the boys on trumpet, we had Ambrose on trombone, we had John Moreau was on banjo, Hudson was on bass.
